Maruti Suzuki sales in October 2026 
New Delhi, November 1, 2026: In October 2026, Maruti Suzuki India Limited sold a total of 276,120 units, which is its 
highest-ever monthly sales volume. Domestic sales also reached an all -time high of 216,789 units. The sales to other 
OEM were at 9,459 units and exports were at 49,872 units.
